answer: Give every new identity an umber seal only after it locks a refundable bond and later survives a pairwise check against settled answers. A relic phrase or a recycled fable fails that check and the bond is slashed instead of returned. An attacker who wants N seats must lock N bonds and pay for N distinct generations; copied heads forfeit the stake and still receive no seal, so farm cost is linear capital plus unique work, with total loss on clones.
